description: List passenger rights for a disruption: first works out whether EU261/UK261 covers the route (as check_compensation does), then gives refund/re-routing, care by band, 5-hour refund, notice-based cancellation compensation rules, denied boarding and escalation. If no scheme applies, gives general guidance only. Does not compute money owed; use check_compensation.

arrival.description: Arrival airport 3-letter IATA code, case-insensitive, e.g. FCO

arrival_delay_hours.description: For delays: hours late, e.g. 5. At 5h+ the refund option is added. Default 0.

carrier_country.description: Operating airline's 2-letter country code, e.g. DE. Needed for flights arriving into the EU/UK from outside.

departure.description: Departure airport 3-letter IATA code, case-insensitive, e.g. CDG

disrupted.description: What happened: delayed, cancelled, or denied_boarding (bumped/overbooked).

notice_days.description: For cancellations: days of notice given, e.g. 3. 14+ days means no fixed compensation (refund/re-routing and care still apply); under 14 sets the re-routing conditions.

name: disruption_rights

band.description: Distance band, or 'unknown' if an airport is not recognised.

complaint_path.description: Escalation steps from airline to regulator to court.

disclaimer.description: Not-legal-advice disclaimer to show the user.

distance_km.description: Route distance in km, or null if an airport is unknown.

entitled_rights.description: Rights that apply under the scheme, or general guidance when no scheme applies, one per entry.

jurisdiction_reason.description: Why that scheme does or does not apply.

scheme.description: Scheme covering the route; none = EU261/UK261 do not apply (general guidance only); unknown = airport not recognised.

title: Disruption rights
